name: Your Company
tagline: Know your body by the numbers, not by guesswork

listing.description: A website for a medical laboratory, clinic or check-up centre. A Swiss grid, a live biomarker panel on the first screen, a test catalogue filterable by category and ready-made check-up panels.

seo.title: Your Company — lab tests and check-ups in Tashkent
seo.description: Blood tests, hormones, vitamins and infections. Results on Telegram within 1 day, a review with a GP, home visits. Walk-in blood draws from 7:00.
seo.answer: Your Company is a medical laboratory on Mirabad Street in Tashkent: a complete blood count costs 60,000 UZS, vitamin D 190,000 UZS and a basic 24-marker check-up 690,000 UZS. Blood is drawn from 7:00 without an appointment, most results arrive on Telegram within a day, and a home visit costs 100,000 UZS.

business.areaServed: Tashkent, home visits across the city

sections.title: Your health in numbers
sections.subtitle: Give blood in ten minutes in the morning and get a clear report on Telegram by evening — plus a GP review if anything is out of range.

sections.label: Tests
sections.title: Test catalogue
sections.intro: Prices include sample collection. Turnaround is in working days from the draw.

items.title: Complete blood count
items.text: Haemoglobin, white cells, platelets, ESR. Ready in 1 day.

items.title: Biochemistry, 12 markers
items.text: Liver, kidneys, cholesterol, glucose. Ready in 1 day.

items.title: Ferritin
items.text: Iron stores — the most common cause of fatigue. Ready in 1 day.

items.title: Sex hormones
items.text: LH, FSH, oestradiol or testosterone. Ready in 2 days.

items.title: Vitamin B12 and folate
items.text: For the nervous system and blood formation. Ready in 2 days.

items.title: Hepatitis B and C
items.text: HBsAg and anti-HCV, required before surgery. Ready in 1 day.

sections.label: How it works
sections.title: From the test tube to a clear answer

items.title: Choose
items.text: Pick tests from the catalogue or a check-up. Not sure? Our admin will help on Telegram.

items.title: Draw
items.text: In the morning on an empty stomach, walk-in from 7:00, or a nurse comes to your home.

items.title: Results
items.text: A PDF and a plain-language summary arrive on Telegram, marking what is in range and what isn’t.

items.title: Review
items.text: If anything is out of range, a GP calls you back and explains which specialist to see next.

items.quote: I gave blood at 7:30 before work and had an annotated report by lunch. For the first time I understood my results without googling.
items.author: Gulnora A.

items.quote: A nurse came to my father’s home at 8 a.m., everything neat and with no queue. The GP called back the same day.
items.author: Timur Kh.

items.a: No, blood is drawn without an appointment from 7:00 to 12:00. You only need to book a home visit or afternoon tests.
Most tests are taken fasting: 8–12 hours without food; water is fine. Avoid alcohol and hard workouts the day before.

items.q: How will I get my results?
items.a: A doctor-signed PDF and a plain summary arrive on Telegram or by email. You can also collect a paper copy at the lab.

items.q: How much is a home visit?
items.a: 100,000 UZS within Tashkent, free for orders over 1,000,000 UZS. Nurses visit between 7:00 and 11:00.
Yes, from age 1. We use fine needles and a separate room for children, and a parent always stays with them.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Book ahead or just walk in
sections.text: Tell us which tests you need — we’ll send preparation tips and the price. For a home visit, include your address and a convenient time.
